title: <study>.variants.json, version 1.0 (ADR 0132, Proposed; completes ADR 0130 A7)
description: The sets of one study that differ in stiffness or another parameter. This is the 1.0 schema: its keys are closed and its version accepts 1.0.x only. Python refuses a newer minor before validating; the app opens a same-major newer file read-only by dropping the keys this schema does not name, at any depth, and validating the rest with this schema (architecture/h5-schema.md, section '<study>.variants.json'). Rules a schema cannot express (unique labels and paths, the name rule's NFC test, confinement after links resolve, that the path names an existing file) are in that section, and a reader applies them per row.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH as a string, read by the floor rule of ADR 0113 (floor 1.0.0). This schema is 1.0's.

name.description: ADR 0130 A2: non-empty, no control character, no leading or trailing whitespace. NFC is checked by the reader, not here.

path.description: The variant's model file <stem>.h5, relative to the folder that holds the manifest, with / as the separator. Subfolders are allowed. No segment is empty, '.' or '..'; no folder segment ends in a dot or a space (Windows strips them); no backslash, colon, control character or leading slash. The last segment is a non-empty stem and .h5, and the path ends in none of the reserved sibling suffixes .geometry.h5, .results.h5, .user.h5 or .workspace.h5. Suffixes match case-insensitively, as the app's classify does.

param.description: A parameter value: a string, a finite number or a boolean. No null, array or object. The bounds refuse a number that overflows to infinity, such as 1e400.
